args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. Flagged: 0. Cleared: 8 (r01–r08).
All three kinematic checks (rigid-body invariance, closure, plane sections) passed on every run. None of the runs used the width-free ratio, and none had roll-backs. Only r06 kept a remedy, and its checks pass after it.
The large |z| values come from a batch MAD of 0, so they overstate small differences. The actual spread is small: centre REGR peak 52.75–52.92 %/h, growth zone 674–705 µm (within 3%), and largest flank difference −11.7 to −12.38 %/h. The peak position (421 µm) and flank-difference position (410 µm) are the same in every run.
No flagged runs, so they have nothing in common to report. The velocity, strain-rate and curvature profiles are the same shape across the batch.
